entities.summary: LAPA Flight 3142 was a scheduled Buenos Aires–Córdoba flight operated by the Argentine airline Líneas Aéreas Privadas Argentinas. On 31 August 1999, the Boeing 737-204C operating the flight crashed while attempting to take off from Aeroparque Jorge Newbery International Airport in Buenos Aires, Argentina.
